description: This PHP source file defines a helper class 'PsrHttpFactoryHelper' that facilitates conversion between PSR-7 HTTP message interfaces and Symfony HTTP Foundation request and response objects. It encapsulates the creation and management of PSR-7 factory objects and provides methods to convert requests and responses between these two representations.

classes.name: PsrHttpFactoryHelper
classes.description: Helper class that manages conversion between Symfony HTTP Foundation request/response objects and PSR-7 message interfaces, utilizing Symfony and Nyholm PSR7 factory classes.

methods.name: getPsrHttpFactory
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of PsrHttpFactory.

methods.name: getHttpFoundationFactory
methods.description: Returns the HttpFoundationFactory instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: createPsr7Request
methods.description: Converts a Symfony Request object into a PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface instance.

methods.name: createPsr7Response
methods.description: Converts a Symfony Response object into a PSR-7 ResponseInterface instance.

methods.name: createRequestFromPsr7Request
methods.description: Creates a Symfony Request object from a PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface object.

methods.name: createResponseFromPsr7Response
methods.description: Creates a Symfony Response object from a PSR-7 ResponseInterface object.
